package main

import (
	"encoding/json"

	"example.com/fixture/internal/policy"
	"example.com/fixture/internal/runtime"
)

func extractPolicy(extra map[string]interface{}) ([]byte, error) {
	_ = policy.ParseConfig(extra)
	return nil, nil
}

func loadNodes(section map[string]interface{}) string { s, _ := section["tier"].(string); return s }

func extractNodes(extra map[string]interface{}) ([]byte, error) {
	section, _ := extra["nodes"].(map[string]interface{})
	return json.Marshal(loadNodes(section))
}

func init() {
	for _, f := range []runtime.GuardedFamily{
		{Section: "policy", Extract: extractPolicy},
		{Section: "nodes", Extract: extractNodes},
	} {
		runtime.RegisterGuardedFamily(f)
	}
}

// dispatch hands the whole [nodes] section to the registered decoder: modeled.
func dispatch(cfg *runtime.Config) string {
	section, _ := cfg.Extra["nodes"].(map[string]interface{})
	if section == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return loadNodes(section)
}

func main() { _ = dispatch(nil); _ = policy.ParseBypass(nil) }
